member.name: T:System.Windows.Media.FillRule
member.summary: Specifies how the intersecting areas of objects contained in a are combined to form the area of the .

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FillRule.EvenOdd
member.summary: Rule that determines whether a point is in the fill region by drawing a ray from that point to infinity in any direction and counting the number of path segments within the given shape that the ray crosses. If this number is odd, the point is inside; if even, the point is outside.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FillRule.Nonzero
member.summary: Rule that determines whether a point is in the fill region of the path by drawing a ray from that point to infinity in any direction and then examining the places where a segment of the shape crosses the ray. Starting with a count of zero, add one each time a segment crosses the ray from left to right and subtract one each time a path segment crosses the ray from right to left. After counting the crossings, if the result is zero then the point is outside the path. Otherwise, it is inside.

member.name: T:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight
member.summary: Describes font embedding permissions specified in an OpenType font file.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.Editable
member.summary: The font may be embedded but must only be installed temporarily on other systems. In contrast to the setting, documents containing Editable fonts may be opened for reading, editing is permitted, and changes may be saved.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.EditableButNoSubsetting
member.summary: The font may be embedded but must only be installed temporarily on other systems. Documents containing the font may be opened for reading, editing is permitted, and changes may be saved. The font may not be subsetted prior to embedding.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.EditableButNoSubsettingAndWithBitmapsOnly
member.summary: The font may be embedded but must only be installed temporarily on other systems. Documents containing the font may be opened for reading, editing is permitted, and changes may be saved. The font may not be subsetted prior to embedding. Only bitmaps contained in the font may be embedded. No outline data may be embedded.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.EditableButWithBitmapsOnly
member.summary: The font may be embedded but must only be installed temporarily on other systems. Documents containing the font may be opened for reading, editing is permitted, and changes may be saved. Only bitmaps contained in the font may be embedded. No outline data may be embedded.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.Installable
member.summary: Fonts with this setting indicate that they may be embedded and permanently installed on the remote system by an application. The user of the remote system acquires the identical rights, obligations and licenses for that font as the original purchaser of the font, and is subject to the same end-user license agreement, copyright, design patent, and/or trademark as was the original purchaser.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.InstallableButNoSubsetting
member.summary: Fonts with this setting indicate that they may be embedded and permanently installed on the remote system by an application. They may not be subsetted prior to embedding.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.InstallableButNoSubsettingAndWithBitmapsOnly
member.summary: Fonts with this setting indicate that they may be embedded and permanently installed on the remote system by an application. They may not be subsetted prior to embedding. Only bitmaps contained in the fonts may be embedded. No outline data may be embedded.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.InstallableButWithBitmapsOnly
member.summary: Fonts with this setting indicate that they may be embedded and permanently installed on the remote system by an application. Only bitmaps contained in the fonts may be embedded. No outline data may be embedded.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.PreviewAndPrint
member.summary: The font may be embedded and temporarily loaded on the remote system. Documents containing the font must be opened in a read-only mode.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.PreviewAndPrintButNoSubsetting
member.summary: The font may be embedded and temporarily loaded on the remote system. Documents containing the font must be opened in a read-only mode. The font may not be subsetted prior to embedding.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.PreviewAndPrintButNoSubsettingAndWithBitmapsOnly
member.summary: The font may be embedded and temporarily loaded on the remote system. Documents containing the font must be opened in a read-only mode. The font may not be subsetted prior to embedding. Only bitmaps contained in the font may be embedded. No outline data may be embedded.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.PreviewAndPrintButWithBitmapsOnly
member.summary: The font may be embedded and temporarily loaded on the remote system. Documents containing the font must be opened in a read-only mode. Only bitmaps contained in the font may be embedded. No outline data may be embedded.

member.name: F:System.Windows.Media.FontEmbeddingRight.RestrictedLicense
member.summary: Fonts with this setting must not be modified, embedded or exchanged in any manner without first obtaining permission of the legal owner.

member.name: P:System.Windows.Media.Imaging.WmpBitmapEncoder.AlphaDataDiscardLevel
member.summary: Gets or sets the level of alpha frequency data to discard during a compressed domain transcode.
member.returns:
The level of alpha data to discard when encoding the image. The value range is 0 (no data discarded) to 4 (alpha channel completely discarded). The default is 1. Value
Description
0
No image frequency data is discarded.
1
FlexBits are discarded. The image quality of the image is reduced without changing the effective resolution of the image.
2
HighPass frequency data band is discarded. The image's effective resolution is reduced by a factor of 4 in both dimensions.
3
HighPass and LowPass frequency data bands are discarded. The image's effective resolution is reduced by a factor of 16 in both dimensions.
4
The alpha channel is completely discarded. The pixel format is changed to reflect the removal of the alpha channel.
member.exception: The value given is not between 0 and 4.

member.name: P:System.Windows.Media.Imaging.WmpBitmapEncoder.AlphaQualityLevel
member.summary: Gets or sets the compression quality for a planar alpha channel.
member.returns: The compression quality for a planar alpha channel image. A value of 1 is considered lossless, and increasing values result in higher compression ratios and lower image quality. The value range is 1 to 255. The default is 1.

Description
0
No overlap processing is enabled.
1
One level of overlap processing is enabled. Encoded values of 4x4 blocks are modified based on the values of neighboring blocks.
2
Two levels of overlap processing are enabled. In addition to the first level of processing, encoded values of 16x16 macro blocks are modified based on the values of neighboring macro blocks.
